method: Live polite probe: >= 1.1 s between requests per host, browser User-Agent, no login, no captcha. One document per tender streamed (first 1 MB) to confirm a real file. Open counts come from TED notices (fixtures/), published 2026-10-21 to 2026-11-20.

quirks: Tender list is filled by JS: POST /Center/api/v2/project/search needs an X-JWT token that the search page only issues once a session cookie exists
TED link /Satellite/notice/{id}/documents redirects through /documents -> /overview?N; a session cookie is needed before the documents tab renders
Wicket page versions (?1, ?2 ...) and ;jsessionid in URLs: strip them for a stable url; the id CX... is stable
Per-tender access varies: some tenders have the Vergabeunterlagen tab disabled (documents only for registered companies)
Whole-tender ZIP at documents/archive/...; ZIPs of 30 MB+ seen
Deadline shown as 'dd.mm.yyyy HH:MM Ortszeit' (Europe/Berlin)
Pages are ISO-8859-1
Same software as dtvp.de under /VMPSatellite/ instead of /Satellite/: a template reuse test
2 of 6 sampled tenders keep the documents tab disabled (land on /overview)
Summary-page trap: TED links of the form ?page=Entreprise.EntrepriseAdvancedSearch&AllCons&id=... land on the search page
TED consultation ids can answer 'L'acces a cette consultation n'est pas autorise': use the ids from the public list
Public list has 1639 results, 10 per page, ASP-like (Prado) pagination
Reglement (RC) or DCE ZIP downloads directly; the full DCE goes through EntrepriseDemandeTelechargementDce with an 'anonymous download' radio option
Slow server: first byte of a document can take > 40 s (use long read timeouts)
Deadline shown as 'dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM (heure de Paris)'
Captcha and login form on every page, but 'telecharger les pieces de maniere anonyme' works without them (the trap named in the brief)
TED links use the old /sdm/ent/gen/ent_detail.do path, which redirects to /sdm/ent2/gen/ficheCsl.action
Large DCE: a 627 MB ZIP seen (over the 250 MB limit, may be skipped)
TED deadlines for this portal carry +02:00 in November: do not trust TED offsets, use Europe/Paris
Angular micro-frontend: the HTML shell is empty and loads ~60 JS chunks, so rendering it at 1 req/s takes > 1 min; read the public JSON API instead
List JSON is Spring-paged (content, totalElements, totalPages); the list mixes notice types (typePublicatie) including award and early-termination notices
Detail JSON: aanbestedingNaam, opdrachtgeverNaam, sluitingsDatum (local time, no offset, Europe/Amsterdam), procedureCode, typeOpdrachtCode, cpvCodes[].code, referentieNummer
Documents: GET .../publicaties/{id}/documenten lists files (documentNaam, grootte in bytes, links.download.href = .../documenten/{docId}/content); links.downloadZip = .../documenten/zip for all files
The Documenten tab in the UI loads only on click; no login or token needed for the JSON API or the downloads
Notice PDF at /papi/tenderned-rs-tns/v2/publicaties/{id}/pdf

portals.docsVerified: files listed anonymously (8 with sha256); download not confirmed
quirks: Vue app; the shell says 'doesn't work properly without JavaScript'
The app first fetches an anonymous token: POST /auth/realms/supplier/protocol/openid-connect/token with grant_type=client_credentials
Documents JSON: versions[].document.originalFileName and fileHash (sha256); 8 files on the sampled tender
Heavy app start: it loads several MB of reference JSON (cities, CPVs, NUTS) first, so a polite render takes minutes; call the JSON API
Angular app (base href /ca/), lazy chunks
Summary-page trap: TED document links point to the buyer profile (/ca/perfils-contractant/detall/{id}), not the tender
List entries carry fasesVigents: ANUNCI_EN_TERMINI = open; ADJUDICACIO / FORMALITZACIO = award phases; lots appear as separate entries (expedientId;lotId)
Detail JSON lists documents with titol, mida (bytes), hash (MD5, not sha256) and an opaque path token; the page groups them under 'Documentacio'

Download in the UI is a JS fetch turned into a blob: URL (no plain href); the size matched 'mida' exactly. The underlying download endpoint was not captured; find it from the XHR log when building the template
Tender pages are public and server-rendered, but every File/Download?fileGuid=... redirects to /bieterportal/Login
'Interesse bekunden' leads to bidder registration
Step 1: ASP.NET postback country selection (Country.aspx)
Step 2: Information.aspx offers an anonymous option ('Ik wens mij niet te identificeren'), but submitting fails with 'De verificatie tegen robots is mislukt' (invisible captcha)

portals.expectedReason: image captcha before the anonymous DCE download
quirks: Both the identified and the anonymous DCE download (fuseaction=dce.cnxAnonyme) show an image captcha ('Texte de l'image')
Not tested whether the captcha is enforced: if it is not, this portal is captcha-bypassable instead. Check by hand in a browser
ColdFusion CFID/CFTOKEN session tokens in URLs: strip them for a stable url
Earlier probe with a bot User-Agent got 403; with a browser User-Agent the Angular shell answers 200 ('Loading...'). Document access not checked
TED links /bandi/aperta/gara-asp/{id} redirect to /opencms/opencms/scheda_altri_bandi.html?idBando={id} or end in HTTP 500 after 3 redirects
Detail page is an AngularJS template; document links are {{ obj.urlDocumento }}. Document access not checked
